title: 43 Functions, $0 a Month: A Backend That Idles for Free | vitalii.no
description:
How splitting a backend into 43 small Deno functions turned an always-on server bill into nothing at all.

The traffic on my platform is spiky and rare — it idles about 95 percent of the time and then needs to do real work: scraping 6 Telegram channels, moving video to YouTube, rewriting articles into three languages, posting to four social platforms. Renting a server that sits awake through all that idling felt like paying rent on an empty room.

The backend is now 43 separate Deno Edge Functions, each one a microservice living at supabase/functions/<name>/index.ts. Each scales on its own and deploys on its own, so a change to the YouTube uploader cannot break the scraper. Shared utilities — YouTube auth, the social helpers, the GitHub Actions triggers — live in a _shared directory rather than being copied 43 times.

The bill is $0 a month on the Supabase free tier, with Pro used only where video processing needs the bigger /tmp. Cold starts stay under 500ms, so nothing feels asleep even when it has been for hours.
